entries.note: Transglobal's first row for an order; the location column says whether it awaits collection or drop-off, which the adapter leaves out.
The partner courier's first row, written with the booking.
Transglobal's driver collected the parcel; the map reads any driver's name between "Collected by" and "(Transglobal)".
Transglobal's depot processed the parcel; the row names the depot, as "Transglobal (Wirral)".

entries.wording: We've received this parcel at the hub and will be sorted to the customers delivery depot
entries.note: Relayed from Evri: its hub took the parcel in.

entries.wording: This parcel is on its way to the courier
entries.note: Relayed from Evri: the parcel left the depot for the courier who delivers it.

entries.wording: The item has been received by the courier and will be out for delivery soon.
entries.note: Relayed from Evri: the delivering courier has the parcel; the round follows.

entries.wording: We're unable to deliver this parcel today. We will now deliver the next working day
entries.note: Relayed from Evri, a minute after the courier's receipt in the morning: no round that day, not a missed delivery.
